title: Change the details on a motor dealer licence
summary: This page explains how to notify NSW Fair Trading if your personal or business details have changed for your motor dealer licence.
intro:
If you have a motor dealer licence and your personal or business information has changed you need to notify NSW Fair Trading.

To check your motor dealer licence number and details visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: Must hold a motor dealer licence and have personal or business information that has changed.
what_you_need: The relevant PDF form for the details you need to change (e.g., Change of Director, Change in Partners, Change of Details Notification).
Completion and submission of the form via the Service NSW Centre.

how_to_steps.text: Download the relevant PDF form for the details you need to change.
Complete the form and submit the form

more_info.text: To find out more about motor dealer licensing visit:

faqs.q: How can I check my motor dealer licence number and details?
faqs.a: You can check your motor dealer licence number and details by visiting Verify NSW.

faqs.q: What do I do if my personal or business information has changed?
faqs.a: If you have a motor dealer licence and your personal or business information has changed, you need to notify NSW Fair Trading.

faqs.q: How do I submit the required forms?
faqs.a: First, download the relevant PDF form for the details you need to change. Then, complete and submit the form via the Service NSW Centre.
